concerns.location: plan.md:## Compute Feasibility & GPU Escape Hatch
concerns.text: The plan includes a ‘Compute Feasibility & GPU Escape Hatch’ section that describes fallback behavior if a library unexpectedly requires CUDA. This behavior is not mentioned in any Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in the spec, so it is an over‑reach beyond the spec’s scope.

The plan adds a detailed power‑analysis, bootstrap resampling, and effect‑size reporting (e.g., rank‑biserial correlation) that are not required by any FR or SC in the specification. While useful, these items constitute plan work not anchored to a spec requirement.
